title: Explicit finite-coefficient subalgebra
statement: Let k be a field and Λ a commutative local k-algebra with residue field K. For a ring homomorphism σ:K→Λ, a finite subset t of Λ, and a finite subset s of K, define C_s to be the k-subalgebra of Λ generated by t ∪ σ(k(s)), where k(s) is the intermediate field generated by s in K. This is Algebra.adjoin k of that set, with its inherited inclusion into Λ.
